719-1018-7507-8043.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell for free using Vision this turn.
719-1018-7507-8043.description:
Cast Kindred Charge for free due to Vision, choosing a creature type granted by Xenograft, creating a token copy of each creature you control with haste, and setting up a delayed exile trigger.
Put the copy of Vision whose ability has been used in your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Skullwinder token enters, it triggers, returning Kindred Charge from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

339-677-2079-7272.notablePrerequisites: You have at least four card types in your graveyard.
339-677-2079-7272.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Reaper of Flight Moonsilver by sacrificing Jegantha, giving Reaper of Flight Moonsilver +2/+1 until end of turn
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

339-677-4247-7296.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

4247-5058-7396.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing the creature that has Screams from Within attached.
When the creature dies, Screams from Within triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to another creature you control.
Quintorius, History Chaser triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat.

1170-5060-5131-6797--202.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-5060-5131-6797--202.notablePrerequisites: There is an artifact card exiled with Cemetery Prowler.
1170-5060-5131-6797--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {0} due to Cemetery Prowler.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the artifact, putting a +1/+1 counter on Phantom Train and causing it to become a creature until end of turn
Repeat.

1496-3490-4050-7743.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1496-3490-4050-7743.description:
Gain life.
Heroic Feast triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Verdant Sun's Avatar triggers, causing you to gain life.
Heroic Feast triggers. Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {1}.
Resolve the Heroic Feast trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control 
Repeat from step 3.

3532-3836-5078-7328.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
3532-3836-5078-7328.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Donatello triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Donatello.
Repeat.

2034-4605-6132-7261.description:
Cast Chord of Calling by paying at most {6}{G}{G}{G}, searching your library for Metamorphosis Fanatic and putting it onto the battlefield.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it and Preston trigger.
Resolve the Metamorphosis Fanatic trigger, returning an applicable target from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
Resolve the Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Metamorphosis Fanatic that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Metamorphosis Fanatic token enters, it triggers, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

2097-4682-4772-5140.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot pay for Smothering Tithe's trigger.
2097-4682-4772-5140.description:
Activate Kenrith's fourth ability by paying {3}{U}, causing an opponent who cannot pay for Smothering Tithe's trigger to draw a card.
Smothering Tithe triggers, causing you to create four Treasure tokens due to Doubling Season and Jolene.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{U}.
Repeat.
2097-4682-4772-5140.notes: Eventually the opponent will lose the game due to drawing from an empty library. You can repeat this loop with other opponents that also cannot pay for Smothering Tithe's trigger.

2792-3227-3647.notablePrerequisites: You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {2}{U}.
2792-3227-3647.description:
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}.
Cast Displace by paying {2}{U}, blinking Scrivener and Great Whale
When Scrivener and Great Whale enter the battlefield, their abilities trigger.
Resolve the Scrivener trigger, returning Displace from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Great Whale trigger, untapping up to seven lands.
Repeat.
2792-3227-3647.notes: If you control seven lands that can tap to produce at least {3}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana, and you may blink any other permanent besides Great Whale.

2292-3234-3293-5226.easyPrerequisites: You control a Plains or have a Plains in your graveyard.
2292-3234-3293-5226.description:
Activate Lithatog by sacrificing a land.
Repeat step 1 until you control no lands.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing World Shaper.
When World Shaper dies, it triggers, return all lands from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter, Emeria Shepherd triggers that many times.
Resolve an Emeria Shepherd trigger that was triggered by a Plains, returning World Shaper from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve all remaining Emeria Shepherd triggers.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat
2292-3234-3293-5226.notes: You can return all nonland permanents in your graveyard and library to the battlefield if you control there are two or more Plains between your graveyard, library and battlefield. To do this, have all triggers from Emeria Shepherd target desired permanents. Then, resolve the Plains triggers first to return those cards to the battlefield, causing all other triggers to fizzle on the stack.

325-1742-1786-6282.easyPrerequisites:
Your life total is at least 2.
You have at least one card in hand.
325-1742-1786-6282.description:
Activate Skirge Familiar by discarding a card, adding {B}.
Toluz's second ability triggers, exiling the discarded card from your graveyard.
Ketramose triggers, causing you to draw a card and lose 1 life.
Queza triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and an opponent to lose 1 life.
Repeat.

2281-3175-5256.description:
Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Sun Titan.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Sun Titan.
When Sun Titan dies, Saffi triggers, returning Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sun Titan enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Saffi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

97-2308-4321-4659.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional Beast.
97-2308-4321-4659.description:
Activate Ravenous Baloth by sacrificing another Beast, causing you to gain 4 life.
Trudge Garden triggers, causing you to pay {2} to create a 4/4 Fungus Beast creature token and a Food artifact token.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Food, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

1379-2047-2253.description:
Cast Army of the Damned by paying {5}{B}{B}{B}, creating thirteen 2/2 Zombie creature tokens that are artifacts due to Mycosynth Lattice.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Mechanized Production triggers, creating a token copy of the artifact it is attached to, and causing you to win the game.

152-3129-5296.description:
Activate Cogwork Assembler by paying {7}, creating two token copies of Workhorse with haste that each enter the battlefield with eight +1/+1 counters on them.
Activate a Workhorse token seven times by removing seven +1/+1 counters from it, adding seven {C}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may instead copy any artifact you control.

760-2164.description:
Cast Chains of Plasma targeting the Swans.
The damage is prevented, and instead you draw 3 cards.
Discard a card to copy Chains of Plasma.
Repeat

1819-2434-3244.description:
Cast Morality Shift by paying {5}{B}{B}, exchanging your graveyard and library.
Syr Konrad triggers once for each creature card that left your graveyard and once for each creature card put into your graveyard; Gaea's Blessing also triggers.
Resolve Gaea's Blessing's trigger, shuffling your graveyard into your library.
Syr Konrad triggers an additional time for each creature card that left your graveyard.
Resolve all of Syr Konrad's triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent for each one.

813-2628-4872.manaNeeded: {4}{U}{U} plus enough mana to cycle the instant/sorcery each turn
813-2628-4872.notablePrerequisites: You have an instant and/or sorcery card in hand with cycling.
813-2628-4872.description:
Cast Time Warp by paying {3}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate any instant/sorcery card in your hand's cycling ability by paying its cycling cost and discarding it.
Escape Protocol triggers, causing you to pay {1} to blink Scholar of the Ages.
Scholar of the Ages enters the battlefield, returning Time Warp and the card with cycling from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the cycling ability from step 2, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat each turn.
